entities.name: Nikolay Maksyuta
entities.label: Person
entities.summary:
Nikolay Kirillovich Maksyuta was a Russian politician who was governor of Volgograd Oblast from 1997–2010. In 1996 he won
the election for governor. He won his last re-election in 2004, and left office at the end of 2009.
